quiz_en: What is the popular name of the temple in Menuma, Kumagaya, known for its main hall designated a National Treasure?

desc_en: Seikeien in the Kamakura-cho area of Kumagaya City is a stroll-style Japanese garden quietly nestled in the city. Trees and stones are arranged around a pond formed by spring water from the underground flow of the Arakawa River, and the scenery changes with every step around the pond. In the streets of Kumagaya, known for its summer heat, it is a place to spend a quiet moment surrounded by water and greenery.
quiz_en: When you walked along the pond at Seikeien Garden, what kind of seasonal scenery did you come across?

desc_en: Hoan-ji in the Minowa area of Kumagaya City is a temple surrounded by houses and fields in western Kumagaya, near the flow of the Arakawa River. The grounds are well kept, with a calm atmosphere that has long been part of local people's daily lives. Kumagaya is known for its summer heat, but stepping into the shaded grounds lets you breathe a sigh of relief in this quiet place of prayer.
quiz_en: When you visit the grounds of a temple, what is it that makes you stop and look without thinking?

desc_en: This fire festival is held at Ogai Shrine in the Menuma area of Kumagaya City. Ogai Shrine stands near Menuma Shoden-zan, known for its National Treasure Shoden-do hall, and has long drawn local worship. On the night of the festival, flames blaze up, and the firelight flickering in the darkness, along with the excitement of the crowd, creates a special night in this town beside the Tone River.
quiz_en: If you watched the flames blazing up at a fire festival, what wish would you put into them?

desc_en: This festival is held when the lotus flowers are at their best at the Ancient Lotus Village in the Kobari area of Gyoda City. The ancient lotuses here are said to have bloomed when seeds that had lain dormant underground sprouted naturally during construction of a public facility. On summer mornings, large pale pink blossoms covering the entire pond are mysteriously beautiful. Nearby you can also see rice paddy art, in which giant pictures are drawn with rice plants.
quiz_en: What is the project near the Ancient Lotus Village in which giant pictures are created using rice plants of different colors?

desc_en: This festival is held during cherry blossom season at Suijo Park in Gyoda City. The park was created making use of remnants of the outer moat of Oshi Castle, and bonbori lanterns gently light up the cherry blossoms blooming around the pond. At night, the blossoms reflected on the water are magical, and you can enjoy an atmospheric spring evening befitting the castle town of Gyoda.
quiz_en: Suijo Park in Gyoda was laid out making use of the old outer moat of which nearby castle?

desc_en: At Hitsujiyama Park in Chichibu City, many varieties of shibazakura (moss phlox) bloom on the Shibazakura Hill each spring, and a festival is held. Pink, white and purple flowers fill the hill as if drawing patterns, while Mount Buko, the symbol of Chichibu, towers behind. The scene woven by the carpet of flowers and the majestic mountain is a landscape that represents spring in Chichibu.
quiz_en: Which mountain, regarded as the symbol of Chichibu, towers behind the flower-covered Shibazakura Hill at Hitsujiyama Park?

desc_en: The Ryusei, offered at the grand annual festival of Muku Shrine in the Yoshida area of Chichibu City, is a traditional event in which handmade wooden rockets built by local farmers are launched. Packed with gunpowder in bamboo tubes, the Ryusei soar into the sky with a roar, trailing white smoke like a dragon ascending to heaven. Each school recites a spoken introduction, and the mountains of Chichibu in autumn are filled with loud cheers.
quiz_en: What are the handmade wooden rockets launched at the festival in the Yoshida area of Chichibu called?

desc_en: Nakatsu Gorge, formed by the Nakatsu River, a tributary of the Arakawa, deep in the backcountry of Chichibu City, is a deep valley lined with sheer rock walls. It is known as one of the best spots for autumn foliage in Saitama Prefecture, and in fall trees dyed red and yellow cover the valley. The scenery woven by the blue of the clear stream and the vivid foliage conveys the depth of the Okuchichibu mountains.
quiz_en: After viewing the autumn leaves at Nakatsu Gorge in Okuchichibu, what local specialty would you want to eat in Chichibu?

desc_en: In places such as Kamitano in the Arakawa district of Chichibu City, weeping cherry trees produce splendid blossoms in spring, and a festival is held. Weeping cherries with long drooping branches bloom in temple grounds and elsewhere, their pale pink flowers cascading down like waterfalls. The simple spring scenery of the mountain village, set against the Chichibu mountains, has a beauty that puts your heart at ease.
quiz_en: To see the weeping cherries of the Arakawa district, would you choose the daytime in full bloom or dusk?

desc_en: Lake Sayama, in the Sayama Hills of Tokorozawa City, is a reservoir built as a source of tap water for Tokyo. The rich forest surrounding the lake is a treasure trove of wild birds, and from the top of the embankment you can see the mountains of Okutama and Chichibu across the water and, on clear days, Mount Fuji. At dusk, the view of the lake with the silhouette of Mount Fuji is exceptional.
quiz_en: Lake Sayama in the Sayama Hills of Tokorozawa is a popular name. What is the official name of this reservoir?

desc_en: This grand festival is held at Yasaka Shrine in the Kaminaguri area of Hanno City. Naguri is a mountain village along the Naguri River, the upper reaches of the Iruma River, long known as a source of Nishikawa timber sent to Edo. On festival day, the sound of festival music echoes through the quiet mountain village, and you can see the heartwarming sight of local people working together to carry on tradition.
quiz_en: What was the timber grown around Hanno, including the Naguri area, and shipped to Edo called?

desc_en: Sogan-ji in the Fudooka area of Kazo City is a Shingon Buddhist temple affectionately known as Fudooka Fudoson. As a Fudo temple for warding off misfortune, it has drawn many worshippers since long ago, and a townscape of shops lines the approach. Its Setsubun event is also famous, crowded with people every year. Kazo is also known as a town of handmade udon, so a bowl after your visit is something to look forward to.
quiz_en: What handmade noodle dish is Kazo City, home of Sogan-ji, famous for as a local specialty?

desc_en: Chikata Shrine in the Chuo area of Kazo City is a shrine located in the middle of the city. Beloved by local people, it welcomes worshippers throughout the four seasons. Kazo is a town on the plain near the Tone River, also known for its thriving production of koinobori (carp streamers), and in spring an event is held in which a giant carp streamer swims through the sky.
quiz_en: What decoration, produced in Kazo City, swims through the sky in giant form at a spring event there?

name_en: Tamashiki Shrine Daruma Market and Setsubun Festival
desc_en: This daruma market and Setsubun festival are held at Tamashiki Shrine in the Kisai area of Kazo City in time for Setsubun. Stalls selling lucky daruma dolls line the grounds, and people wish for good fortune for the year amid the shouts of the bean-throwing ritual. Tamashiki Shrine is an ancient shrine also known for its kagura (sacred dance) tradition, and in the clear winter air the grounds are filled with New Year energy.
quiz_en: If you bought a lucky daruma at the Tamashiki Shrine daruma market, which eye would you paint in first?

desc_en: This festival is held at Wakaizumi Park in Honjo City to coincide with the peak of the spring cherry blossoms. When the park's cherry trees are in full bloom, it bustles with local people enjoying blossom viewing. Honjo once flourished as the largest post town on the Nakasendo road, so after enjoying the cherry blossoms, a walk tracing the history of the old town is also recommended.
quiz_en: Along which Edo-period highway did Honjo once flourish as the largest of all the post towns?

desc_en: The peony garden of Ryugan-ji in the Takise area of Honjo City is a flower spot where the temple grounds are adorned with large peonies in spring. Peonies with many layered petals bloom in competing colors, and combined with the calm atmosphere of the temple, they create a scene that is gorgeous yet elegant. Strolling the grounds wrapped in the fragrance of the flowers is a special pleasure.
quiz_en: What is your favorite color of peony that you would like to see at the peony garden of Ryugan-ji?

desc_en: This spring grand festival is held at Santai Shrine in the Yomoda area of Honjo City. Santai Shrine is worshipped as a deity of safe childbirth and child-raising, and on festival day stalls line the surrounding area, which bustles with families with children. As an event announcing the arrival of spring in Honjo's farmland, it has long been cherished by local people.
quiz_en: At a shrine known for its deity of safe childbirth and child-raising, whose happiness would you pray for?

name_en: Koyama River Thousand Cherry Trees Festival
desc_en: A long row of cherry trees lines the floodplain of the Koyama River, which flows through the Kodama area of Honjo City, and a festival is held in spring. Walking through the tunnel of cherry blossoms that tints the riverside embankment pale pink, you will come across the charming sight of petals fluttering down onto the river. Kodama is also known as the hometown of Hanawa Hokiichi, a blind scholar of Japanese classics.
quiz_en: Who was the blind Edo-period scholar of Japanese classics whose hometown was Kodama in Honjo City?

desc_en: This spring cherry blossom festival centers on Takinomiya Shrine in Fukaya City. When the cherry trees in and around the shrine grounds are in full bloom, the scenery around the spring-fed pond is wrapped in soft spring colors. Fukaya is known for its specialty Fukaya green onions and is also the hometown of Shibusawa Eiichi, the face of the new 10,000-yen note. After blossom viewing, you can also enjoy touring places associated with Shibusawa.
quiz_en: Which businessman from Fukaya City was chosen as the portrait on Japan's new 10,000-yen banknote?

desc_en: The post town festival held in Soka City conveys the history of Soka, which flourished as a post town on the Nikko Kaido road. Along the Ayase River stretches Soka Matsubara, a row of pine trees, also known as a place associated with Matsuo Basho's The Narrow Road to the Deep North. On festival day the town is full of energy, and the savory aroma of the famous Soka senbei rice crackers fills the air.
quiz_en: What savory baked treat is known as the famous specialty of Soka, a post town on the Nikko Kaido road?

desc_en: This festival is held at Koshigaya Bairin Park in the Obayashi area of Koshigaya City when the plum blossoms are at their best. Many plum trees, including red and white varieties, grow in the park, and with the arrival of early spring their delicate flowers bloom and a sweet fragrance drifts through the air. You can enjoy peaceful plum viewing and feel spring a little early in a still-chilly season.
quiz_en: At the plum festival in Koshigaya Bairin Park, which would you rather see: red plum or white plum blossoms?

desc_en: This post town festival centers on Nakasendo Honcho-dori street in Warabi City. Warabi-juku flourished as the second post town on the Nakasendo after leaving Edo, and at the festival, processions and events evoking the post town era brighten the street. Warabi City is also known as the smallest city in Japan by area, and its compact townscape retains a sense of history.
quiz_en: Warabi City, once a post town on the Nakasendo, is known as Japan's smallest city in terms of what?

desc_en: Asaka City's Saikasai is a summer festival centered on the Kanhasshu Yosakoi Festa, which brings together yosakoi dance teams from across the Kanto region. Dancers holding naruko clappers parade and dance through the city in vivid costumes, and spectators are drawn in by the powerful performances. At night, fireworks are launched, brilliantly decorating Asaka's summer night sky.
quiz_en: What is the wooden clapper that yosakoi dancers hold in their hands and rattle as they dance called?

desc_en: This Hansobo Grand Festival is held at Heirin-ji in the Nobidome area of Niiza City. Heirin-ji is a Rinzai Zen temple with vast grounds of mixed woodland that preserve the look of old Musashino, and it is also known for the grave of Matsudaira Nobutsuna, lord of the Kawagoe Domain. On the day of the grand festival, worshippers visit the Hansobo hall in the grounds, and the usually quiet Zen temple forest comes alive.
quiz_en: Who was the Edo-period daimyo known as Chie Izu, or Izu the Wise, whose grave is at Heirin-ji in Niiza?

desc_en: Shiroyama Park in the Kawataya area of Okegawa City spreads across a plateau near the Arakawa River. Laid out on land where a medieval fortified residence is said to have stood, it has wide lawns, a pond, sports facilities and more. Mixed woodland and farmland remain in the surrounding area, and families spend carefree time here surrounded by seasonal flowers and greenery.
quiz_en: In a large park like Shiroyama Park, how would you most like to spend your day off?

desc_en: Washinomiya Shrine in Kuki City is known as one of the oldest shrines in the Kanto region. The Haji Ichiryu Saibara Kagura handed down here is said to be a source of Kanto's kagura (sacred dance) and is designated a national Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property. In recent years it has also drawn attention as the setting of an anime, and many fans have come to visit from all over Japan.
quiz_en: What is the name of the kagura dance handed down at Washinomiya Shrine and designated an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property?

desc_en: This festival is held at Shobu Shrine in the Shobu area of Kuki City when the wisteria is at its best. Long clusters of pale purple flowers hang from the wisteria trellis in the grounds, swaying elegantly in the wind. Drawn by the sweet fragrance, many people visit. Shobu is a town of flowers also known for growing lavender, and in early summer purple blossoms color the area here and there.
quiz_en: At the Shobu Shrine Wisteria Festival, what color are the flowers hanging down from the wisteria trellis?

desc_en: Tenjinsha in the Honjuku area of Kitamoto City is a local guardian shrine dedicated to the god of learning. Kitamoto was once home to a post town on the Nakasendo, and traces of this can be felt in the place name Honjuku, meaning original post town. The quiet grounds surrounded by trees are a place of relaxation for local people, and in exam season you can also see worshippers praying for success.
quiz_en: If you prayed for exam success at Tenjinsha, what words would you write on your ema wooden plaque?

desc_en: Hikawa Shrine in the Takao area of Kitamoto City stands on a plateau overlooking the Arakawa River. Mixed woodland and yato valley landforms remain in the area, giving it the atmosphere of the satoyama countryside typical of Musashino. Hikawa shrines are found in large numbers in Saitama Prefecture and Tokyo, and their head shrine is Hikawa Shrine in Omiya, Saitama City.
quiz_en: Hikawa shrines are common in Saitama and Tokyo. In which city is the head shrine of all Hikawa shrines located?

desc_en: Misato Park in the Takasu area of Misato City is a waterside park spreading along the shore of the Koaidame reservoir on the border with Tokyo. Across the water lies Tokyo's Mizumoto Park, and you can enjoy an open landscape where the waterside scenery merges as one. You can spend relaxed time picnicking on the wide lawns or strolling along the water.
quiz_en: What Tokyo park spreads across the water from Misato Park, on the opposite shore of the Koaidame?

desc_en: The Gongendo cherry embankment in Satte City is a famous cherry blossom spot where about a thousand Somei-Yoshino cherry trees line a bank along the Naka River. In spring, rapeseed blossoms bloom all over beneath the tunnel of cherry trees, creating a splendid contrast of pale pink and yellow. With hydrangeas in early summer and red spider lilies in autumn, it is loved as a flower spot throughout the year.
quiz_en: At the Gongendo cherry embankment in Satte, what flower colors the bank yellow together with the cherry blossoms in spring?

desc_en: This spring cherry blossom festival is held in the Otagaya area of Tsurugashima City. When the cherry trees around the venue are in full bloom, it bustles with local people enjoying blossom viewing. Tsurugashima is a residential city spreading across the Musashino plateau, and this is a relaxing event where you can feel the change of seasons close to home. You can spend a leisurely time under the cherry blossoms with family and friends.
quiz_en: At the Tsurugashima Cherry Blossom Festival, who would you like to spend time with under the cherry trees in full bloom?

desc_en: Lake Kamakita, in the mountains of Moroyama Town, is an irrigation pond built for agricultural water, a quiet lake surrounded by the mountains of Okumusashi. Cherry blossoms on the shore in spring and colorful foliage in autumn adorn the lake surface, changing its look with each season. It is also the starting point of hiking trails, and many people visit in combination with a mountain walk.
quiz_en: If you visited Lake Kamakita in Okumusashi, would you rather go in spring for the cherry blossoms or in autumn for the foliage?

desc_en: Kuroyama Santaki in Ogose Town is the collective name for three waterfalls: Odaki, Medaki and Tengu Falls. Odaki and Medaki, continuing in upper and lower tiers, fall as if nestled together, while Tengu Falls lies a little apart. Long known as a training site for Shugendo mountain ascetics, the gorge wrapped in fresh greenery or autumn leaves refreshes the soul with the sound of clear water.
quiz_en: The three falls of Kuroyama Santaki are Odaki, Medaki and one more. What is the third waterfall called?

desc_en: Kijin Shrine in Ranzan Town is a shrine that enshrines oni (ogres), something rare in Japan. At the bean-throwing ritual of its Setsubun Festival, the custom is to chant 'Fortune in, ogres in, devils out,' and this unique chant rings out, welcoming the oni instead of driving them away. Iron clubs are offered in the grounds, and many worshippers visit this unusual Setsubun event.
quiz_en: At Kijin Shrine's Setsubun bean-throwing, the chant begins 'Fortune in, ogres...' Are the ogres told to come in or go out?

desc_en: This spring festival is held on the cherry embankment of the Toki River flowing through Ranzan Town. The rows of cherry trees along the river reach full bloom, and the combination of clear water and blossoms creates a splendid scene. The name Ranzan comes from Musashi Ranzan, named because a nearby gorge resembles Arashiyama in Kyoto, and you can fully enjoy spring by this peaceful river.
quiz_en: Ranzan Town in Saitama was named because its scenery resembles which famous scenic spot elsewhere in Japan?

desc_en: Mount Monomi in the Ishizaka area of Hatoyama Town is a gentle mountain in the Hiki Hills. True to its name, meaning lookout mountain, it is loved as a place with fine views, and walking the trails surrounded by mixed woodland, you can see the rolling hills and countryside scenery. It is a low mountain that is easy to climb, perfect for a leisurely hike while enjoying encounters with seasonal flowers and wild birds.
quiz_en: From a hill with a fine view like Mount Monomi, what kind of scenery would you most like to look out on?

desc_en: Usui Pass, on the border between Hatoyama Town and Ranzan Town, crosses through the Hiki Hills. In the Nanbokucho period it was the stage of the Battle of Usui Pass, fought between the forces of the Nitta clan and Ashikaga Takauji. Today it is a quiet pass road surrounded by mixed woodland, where you can enjoy a walk tracing remnants of the old Kamakura Kaido road while reflecting on its history of battle.
quiz_en: At Usui Pass in Hatoyama, which warlord fought against the forces of the Nitta clan during the Nanbokucho period?

desc_en: Hodosan Shrine in Nagatoro Town, at the foot of Mount Hodo, is one of the foremost ancient shrines of the Chichibu region. The shrine's name is said to derive from a legend in which Yamato Takeru was rescued by mountain dogs when caught in a mountain fire. The shrine buildings decorated with richly colored carvings are well worth seeing, and at the summit, reached by ropeway, wintersweet blooms in yellow profusion in winter.
quiz_en: Which flower colors the summit of Mount Hodo yellow in winter and gives off a sweet fragrance?

desc_en: Mount Ryokami in Ogano Town is a celebrated peak of Okuchichibu counted among Japan's 100 Famous Mountains. It is characterized by a rugged form of jagged rocky ridges and has been revered as a sacred mountain since ancient times. With chain-assisted sections on the trail, it is popular among climbers as a challenging mountain. From the summit you can see across the mountains of Okuchichibu.
quiz_en: After finishing the climb up the rocky sections of Mount Ryokami, what is the first thing you would want to do at the summit?

desc_en: Mount Azumaya in the Ryokami area of Ogano Town is an approachable mountain with famous flower spots at its foot. The Ryokami area at its base is known as a habitat of wild setsubunso (Eranthis pinnatifida), whose delicate white flowers bloom in early spring, heralding its arrival. There are rocky sections near the summit, offering an easy yet varied hike.
quiz_en: What white flower blooms in early spring at the foot of Mount Azumaya, opening around the time of Setsubun?

desc_en: Mount Futago in the Kawarasawa area of Ogano Town is a limestone mountain with, as its name meaning twin peaks suggests, two peaks side by side. Its sheer rock walls are known as one of Japan's leading rock climbing spots, attracting many climbers. From the summit you can see across the Chichibu mountains, and the rugged rock formations are striking.
quiz_en: What climbing sport is enjoyed on the sheer rock walls of Mount Futago in Ogano Town?

desc_en: Onouchi Gorge in the Kawarasawa area of Ogano Town is a small gorge of clear streams and rocky areas. In winter, giant icicles made by drawing water from the stream fill the gorge, and many visitors come to see the Onouchi Hyakkei Icicles. The world of ice seen from the suspension bridge spanning the gorge is overwhelming, and the nighttime illumination is magical.
quiz_en: What ice formations, created using water from the mountain stream, can be seen at Onouchi Gorge in winter?

desc_en: Marugami Falls in the Ryokami Komori area of Ogano Town is a famous waterfall representing Saitama Prefecture, selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Waterfalls. It is characterized by its graceful form, falling in three tiers, and cool air drifts around the plunge pool surrounded by forest. In the seasons of fresh greenery and autumn leaves, the white stream harmonizes beautifully with the colors of the mountains.
quiz_en: What is the name of the nationwide list of one hundred famous waterfalls that Marugami Falls has been selected for?

desc_en: Jomine Park in the Yano area of Kamikawa Town spreads across a mountainside overlooking Lake Kanna. It is known for its winter cherry trees, which bloom from autumn into winter, and at their peak you can enjoy the rare sight of autumn leaves and white winter cherry blossoms at the same time. Ordinary cherry trees also bloom in spring, making it a place to savor mountain nature throughout the year.
quiz_en: Which flower blooms at Jomine Park from autumn into winter, sharing the stage with the autumn leaves?

desc_en: Lake Tsuburata in the Sueno area of Yorii Town is an agricultural irrigation pond built in the mountains, a quiet lake surrounded by green forest. People can be seen enjoying fishing, and a walking path around the lakeshore has been developed. Spring cherry blossoms and autumn leaves are reflected on the lake surface, showing a different beauty each season.
quiz_en: At a quiet mountain lake like Lake Tsuburata, what would you most like to try doing there?

desc_en: Mount Kanetsukido in Yorii Town is said to get its name from a lookout post for Hachigata Castle placed here in the Sengoku period, where a bell was rung to warn of trouble. It is a low mountain that is easy to climb, and from the summit you can see the townscape of Yorii, the Kanto Plain and, on clear days, distant mountains. A bell hangs at the summit, and some people ring it to commemorate their climb.
quiz_en: Which castle is said to have placed a lookout on Mount Kanetsukido and used a bell to warn of trouble?

desc_en: Straddling Yorii Town, Minano Town and other areas, Mount Kamabuse is part of the Sotochichibu mountain range, with Kamabuse Shrine standing near its summit. In the Fuppu area at its foot springs Yamato Mizu, selected as one of the Ministry of the Environment's 100 Best Waters of Japan. It is a mountain of water and faith, where you can taste pure, famous spring water after a hike.
quiz_en: What is the name of the spring water, selected as one of Japan's 100 Best Waters, that wells up in Fuppu at the foot of Mount Kamabuse?

desc_en: Chiba Shrine in Chuo Ward, Chiba City, is known as the head shrine of Myoken, enshrining Hokushin Myoken Sonjo-o. Myoken, deeply revered by the Chiba clan that ruled the Chiba area from the Heian period, is a star deity who personifies the North Star and the Big Dipper. Its two-story shrine building is an unusual structure, and it draws many worshippers as a shrine for warding off misfortune from all directions.
quiz_en: Myoken, the deity enshrined at Chiba Shrine, is a deification of what in the night sky?

desc_en: Inage Sengen Shrine in Inage Ward, Chiba City, enshrines Konohanasakuya-hime, the deified spirit of Mount Fuji. The sea once came right up to the front of the shrine grounds, and its torii standing in the sea was a famous sight. Land reclamation has since pushed the coastline far away, but the grounds surrounded by pine woods retain traces of its days as a seaside shrine, and the grand summer festival draws lively crowds.
quiz_en: Who is the goddess regarded as the deity of Mount Fuji who is enshrined at Inage Sengen Shrine?

desc_en: Chiba Zoological Park in Wakaba Ward, Chiba City, is a zoo where a wide variety of animals live on spacious grounds. It became known nationwide as the home of Futa, a red panda who made headlines for standing upright on his hind legs. With grassland-like exhibit areas and corners where children can interact with animals, families can enjoy a full day here.
quiz_en: What was the name of the red panda at Chiba Zoological Park who became famous for standing up on his hind legs?
